passages.title: Gym Notice 1
passages.text: POOL CLOSED FOR MAINTENANCE. The swimming pool will be unavailable from Monday to Wednesday due to essential repairs. Normal hours resume on Thursday morning. Thank you for your patience.

passages.title: Gym Notice 2
passages.text: NEW CLASS ALERT: Yoga for Beginners starts this Friday at 6 PM in Studio B. Please sign up at the reception desk at least 24 hours in advance to secure your spot.

passages.title: Gym Notice 3
passages.text: LOST PROPERTY: A blue water bottle and a pair of black trainers were found in the changing rooms yesterday. Please see the gym manager if these items belong to you.

passages.title: Gym Notice 4
passages.text: MEMBERS ONLY: Please ensure you scan your membership card every time you enter the gym. Guests are only permitted when accompanied by a full member.

passages.title: Gym Notice 5
passages.text: FREE TOWEL SERVICE: We are now providing complimentary towels for all gym users. Please return your used towel to the laundry bin near the exit before leaving.

questions.question: What does the notice say about the pool?
questions.explanation: The pool will be closed for three days for repairs.
options: a) It will reopen on Thursday.
b) It is only open in the mornings.
c) It is closed for the whole week.

questions.question: How can you join the new yoga class?
questions.explanation: You must register at the reception at least one day before the class.
options: b) By booking at the desk in advance.
c) By arriving early on Friday.

questions.question: What should you do if you lost your trainers?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs the owner to speak to the gym manager.
options: a) Check the lost property box yourself.
b) Leave a note at the reception.
c) Speak to the person in charge.

questions.question: What is the rule for bringing guests to the gym?
questions.explanation: Guests can only enter if a member is with them.
options: a) Guests can enter at any time.
b) A member must be present with the guest.
c) Guests must have their own membership card.

questions.question: What must users do after using the towels?
questions.explanation: The notice asks users to put the used towel in the bin.
options: a) Put them in the bin near the exit.
b) Take them home to wash.
c) Leave them on the gym floor.
